scope: Explicit XYZWPR relative composition and INV inversion with portable rigid geometry

reference_basis.documented: Relative frame transformation is order dependent; colon shares precedence with vector products; INV reverses a POSITION frame and preserves its configuration
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native XYZWPR overload/result conversion, exact Euler/singular conventions and composition configuration propagation are not authenticated

implementation_choices.types: Complete initialized exact XYZWPR operands/results only; INV is a fallback preserving internal routines and ordinary names
implementation_choices.rotation: Degree Rz(r) Ry(p) Rx(w) on column vectors; reduce angles modulo 360 before trig; retain exact quarter turns and otherwise use rounded Python floats
implementation_choices.composition: R=Ra Rb and t=ta+Ra tb; left-associated colon chains at vector-product precedence; copy right CONFIG without solving robot configuration; group geometry inside READ/WRITE items and formats to retain format diagnostics
implementation_choices.inverse: R=transpose(Ra), t=-transpose(Ra) ta; preserve independent input CONFIG data
implementation_choices.canonical: P in -90..90, W/R in [-180,180); hypot(R00,R10)<=1e-12 chooses W=0 and remaining rotation in R
implementation_choices.guards: Validate nominal shapes, all scalar leaves, finite components and CONFIG bounds; finite output translations without imposing POS constructor coordinate limits
implementation_choices.effects: Evaluate/copy each operand once before later operands; independent output; unchanged assignment target on operation failure, prior effects retained; ordinary FOR and frame cleanup
implementation_choices.reports: Source-located frame_operations and current frame_policy without duplicate receiver lookup entries

retained_boundaries: No POSITION/XYZWPREXT/JOINTPOS/VECTOR transform operands or implicit conversion
No external axes, controller UFRAME/UTOOL discovery, kinematics, reachability, robot turns or native configuration equivalence
Strict remains future work; independent quaternion and authored fixture checks establish offline geometry only
